standing_words.engine: the block only arranges what the engine laws it cites require; it carries no balance value
standing_words.shipped: the block repeats a shape that shipped content already uses; exemplars name it
standing_words.proposed: the block rests on a value the director has not ratified; compile says so every time it is used

_meta.purpose: Roles. An archetype maps to a role the build skill's enemy.py already knows and adds no number of its own. Shaped archetypes (bruiser, caster and the rest) are added as entries once D-05 is ruled.

failure_modes: The multipliers and kit size behind this role are read from enemy.py at compile time; this entry holds none of them.
The role table has no ratification record (INVENTORY C-05, decision D-05), so every use is reported as resting on a proposed value.
archetype/standard/v1.notes: Stat shape is uniform: a shaped stat block is a balance opinion and waits for D-05.
